name: sit_rest-seated-loop-v3-root-locked
purpose: Root-locked re-normalization of the readable v2 seated gesture, eliminating whole-character drift before any further art regeneration.
horizontal_anchor: midpoint of the two visible shoe components in the bottom 12 percent of the character bounds
normalization_rule: Only uniform whole-character scaling and whole-character translation are used. No local translation, part compositing, deformation, interpolation, optical flow, morphing or cross-fade.
rejection_reason: After shoe midpoint, baseline and visible height were locked, the head center still ranged by 25.761 px. The v2 support pose changed internal head-to-feet geometry and cannot be repaired by whole-character placement alone.
